script.cover_1: Shouted at in front of the whole team. Is that normal?
script.payoff: It is poor behaviour, and your company's conduct policy may cover it.
script.caption: Being corrected is fine and being shouted at is not the same thing. Send this to someone who goes quiet in meetings.
script.situation: Can your manager shout at you in front of the team?
script.answer: It is poor behaviour. Your company's conduct policy may cover it, and HR can show you.
script.reply_me: Could we talk about feedback one on one? It is easier for me to take it in that way.
